capabilities: capture memos as card blocks in daily notes
filter the memo feed by text, tag, query or date
create and complete task cards with a slider toggle
soft-delete memos and restore them from a recycle bin
migrate legacy single-line memos to the card-block format
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.7.2 or newer. A data health check creates automatic backups in .rememo-backup/ before migrating files; legacy memos from the old plugin do not render until migrated.
intentEvidence: a heavily rewritten fork of Obsidian-Memos
problem: Quick-capture memos in Obsidian are usually stored in a private database or scattered text; this keeps them as plain Markdown card blocks inside daily notes.

relations.evidence: Built on top of Obsidian-Memos by Boninall (Quorafind)
with design inspiration from memos and flomo
with design inspiration from memos and flomo

summary: Memo feed plugin, forked from Obsidian-Memos, that captures quick thoughts as card blocks inside your daily notes.
